name: Sunshine Chicken
notes: A long-time family favorite, made by many a college cousin.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Prepare the sauce by combining **1 tsp salt**, **1 tsp basil**, **1 tsp ground pepper**, **½ cup soy sauce**, **½ cup ketchup**, **¼ cup honey**, **¼ cup oil** and **2 cloves garlic**.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.body: In an oiled pan, place **8 chicken thighs**. Sprinkle with salt, basil and ground pepper.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Baste chicken with sauce, then bake at 350°F, uncovered, and basting frequently, for about 1 hour.
